source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
If this unit ever has no **PINK HORROR** models, it uses the **BLUE HORRORS** datasheet.

**Designer's Note**: while any **PINK HORROR** model remains in this unit, the Exploding Horrors and Sullen Malevolence abilities of the **BLUE HORRORS** datasheet are not in effect for it.

detail.condition: unit contains no PINK HORROR models

designerNote.while: one or more PINK HORROR models in the unit
